<div class="sop-tab-label">Spheres of Guile</div>

*Source: [Spheres of Guile](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/431419/Spheres-of-Guile?affiliate_id=549120)*

The life of an agent generally involves laying low and staying out of people’s notice, and yet some agents eschew such skullduggery, instead working out in the open. These superstar spies function out in the open, using their fame and renown to accomplish their goals in the same fashion as others in their field, always craving the spotlight.

## Renown (Ex)

At 1st level, the superstar spy gains the renown social talent of the vigilante class, although they are always treated as though they are in their social identity.

This ability replaces the ploy class feature.

## Stalker Talent (Ex)

At 2nd level and again at 10th level, the agent gains a vigilante talent from the vigilante class (Pathfinder Roleplaying Game Ultimate Intrigue), adding their agent level to their vigilante level for the purpose of vigilante talents. They qualify for talents as if they had the stalker specialization. If they have a vigilante talent that adds an effect to hidden strike, they can add it to a discerning strike as long as they do not add it to hidden strike on the same attack.

## Social Talent (Ex)

At 8th level and every four levels thereafter, the agent gains a social talent from the vigilante class (Pathfinder Roleplaying Game Ultimate Intrigue), adding their agent level to their vigilante level for the purpose of social talents.

This ability replaces the just a bad dream, you do not know me, and ghost class features, as well as the what were we doing? option of the discerning strike class feature.
